modalities.evidence: acquired with a CBV-sensitive VASO sequence

output.population: Human participants scanned across multiple sessions; the first participant used an earlier sequence version judged too artifact-dominated to be usable, with sub-02 the main participant.
output.summary: Whole-brain layer-dependent fMRI dataset with cerebral blood volume and BOLD contrast, acquired test-retest with quality metrics, intended as a test bed for developing and benchmarking layer-dependent analysis tools.
